# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the behavior and the owning architecture boundary.

## Validation

- [ ] Focused regression tests and user documentation updated
- [ ] Ruff, mypy, tests, package build, and dependency audit pass
- [ ] ADR added when an accepted architecture decision changes

## Contract impact

List affected public APIs, lifecycle or failure semantics, security boundaries, and any unverified
deployment assumptions.
